full_description: Same tabletop scene (bell + stapler + 1-2 graspable objects); the instruction verb selects the task: touch the bell's top center, press the stapler in place, or pick up the one named object.
schema: {A}=bell (touch/click templates ONLY), {B}=stapler (press templates ONLY), {C}=picked object (pick templates ONLY), {a}=arm. Each template contains exactly one of {A}/{B}/{C}; that lone placeholder routes it to its mode via filter_instructions. Templates are borrowed from the native raw-task pools: click_bell ({A} kept), press_stapler ({A}->{B}), adjust_bottle ({A}->{C}, bottle-orientation wording dropped).
preference: borrowed verbatim from native pools; see schema for routing
